## Configuration in MegaLinter

- Enable lintlang by adding `AI_LINTLANG` in [ENABLE_LINTERS variable](https://megalinter.io/beta/configuration/#activation-and-deactivation)
- Disable lintlang by adding `AI_LINTLANG` in [DISABLE_LINTERS variable](https://megalinter.io/beta/configuration/#activation-and-deactivation)

| Variable | Description | Default value |
| ----------------- | -------------- | -------------- |
| AI_LINTLANG_ARGUMENTS | User custom arguments to add in linter CLI call<br/>Ex: `-s --foo "bar"` |  |
| AI_LINTLANG_COMMAND_REMOVE_ARGUMENTS | User custom arguments to remove from command line before calling the linter<br/>Ex: `-s --foo "bar"` |  |
| AI_LINTLANG_FILTER_REGEX_INCLUDE | Custom regex including filter<br/>Ex: `(src\|lib)` | Exclude no file |
| AI_LINTLANG_FILTER_REGEX_EXCLUDE | Custom regex excluding filter<br/>Ex: `(test\|examples)` | Exclude no file |
| AI_LINTLANG_CLI_LINT_MODE | Override default CLI lint mode<br/>- `list_of_files`: Call the linter with the list of files as argument | `list_of_files` |
| AI_LINTLANG_FILE_EXTENSIONS | Allowed file extensions. `"*"` matches any extension, `""` matches empty extension. Empty list excludes all files<br/>Ex: `[".py", ""]` | Exclude every file |
| AI_LINTLANG_FILE_NAMES_REGEX | File name regex filters. Regular expression list for filtering files by their base names using regex full match. Empty list includes all files<br/>Ex: `["Dockerfile(-.+)?", "Jenkinsfile"]` | `["(?i:(AGENTS|CLAUDE|GEMINI)\\.md)", "(?i:.*(agent|agents|prompt|prompts|tool|tools|skill|skills|system|instruction|instructions).*\\.(json|md|prompt|py|txt|yaml|yml))"]` |
| AI_LINTLANG_PRE_COMMANDS | List of bash commands to run before the linter| None |
| AI_LINTLANG_POST_COMMANDS | List of bash commands to run after the linter| None |
| AI_LINTLANG_UNSECURED_ENV_VARIABLES  | List of env variables explicitly not filtered before calling AI_LINTLANG and its pre/post commands| None |
| AI_LINTLANG_DISABLE_ERRORS | Run linter but consider errors as warnings | `false` |
| AI_LINTLANG_DISABLE_ERRORS_IF_LESS_THAN | Maximum number of errors allowed | `0` |
| AI_LINTLANG_TIMEOUT_SECONDS | Maximum duration in seconds of the linter run, after which the linter process and its child processes are killed and reported as an error (exit code 124). Overrides LINTER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS. 0 disables the timeout | `300` |
| AI_LINTLANG_CLI_EXECUTABLE | Override CLI executable | `['lintlang']` |

## Use this plugin

Add the descriptor URL of the plugin to `PLUGINS` in `.mega-linter.yml`. MegaLinter installs the plugin when it starts, whatever the flavor:

```yaml
PLUGINS:
  - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hermes-labs-ai/lintlang/main/mega-linter-plugin-lintlang/lintlang.megalinter-descriptor.yml
```

## Behind the scenes

### How are identified applicable files

- File names (regex): `(?i:(AGENTS|CLAUDE|GEMINI)\.md)`, `(?i:.*(agent|agents|prompt|prompts|tool|tools|skill|skills|system|instruction|instructions).*\.(json|md|prompt|py|txt|yaml|yml))`

<!-- markdownlint-disable -->
<!-- /* cSpell:disable */ -->
### How the linting is performed

- lintlang is called once with the list of files as arguments (`list_of_files` CLI lint mode)

### Example calls

```shell
lintlang scan AGENTS.md --fail-on fail
```

```shell
lintlang scan agent.yaml tools.json --fail-on fail
```


### Installation in Docker

MegaLinter runs these commands when it loads the plugin (only `RUN` instructions):

```dockerfile
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir lintlang==0.8.3
```

### Installation without Docker (native mode)

> **Native mode does not run plugins yet**: this section shows what the plugin declares for native mode.

Not available: see the MegaLinter checks of the plugin.

## MegaLinter checks

These results last changed on 2026-11-28, and MegaLinter checks the plugins every day. The checks only look at the descriptor of the plugin: they do not review the plugin, nor the tool it runs.

| Check | Result |
| :---- | :----- |
| Descriptor | ⚠️ Incomplete |
| Native mode | ❌ Not supported |
| SARIF output | ❌ |
| Native lock | ⚠️ No lock shipped by the plugin author |

### Required

Missing required items:

- **`native_install` declared and valid for the 5 native platforms** (`AI_LINTLANG`): Native mode (MegaLinter without Docker) can not install the linter. Declare `native_install`, listing each of linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/amd64, darwin/arm64 and windows/amd64 in `platforms` or in `unsupported` (with a reason)
- **SARIF output** (`AI_LINTLANG`): The findings are missing from SARIF reports (GitHub code scanning, SARIF viewers, coding agents). Set `can_output_sarif: true` with `cli_sarif_args` when the tool outputs SARIF, otherwise `sarif_text_regex` (one finding per line of text) or `sarif_unified_diff: true` (formatters printing a diff)

### Recommended

Missing recommended items:

- **Native lock shipped next to the descriptor (`<name>.megalinter-native-lock.json`), for verified native installs**
- **Rules documentation URL (`linter_rules_url`)** (`AI_LINTLANG`)
- **Configuration documentation URL (`linter_rules_configuration_url`)** (`AI_LINTLANG`)
- **Inline disable documentation URL (`linter_rules_inline_disable_url`)** (`AI_LINTLANG`)
- **Ignore file documentation URL (`linter_rules_ignore_config_url`)** (`AI_LINTLANG`)
- **SPDX license (`linter_spdx_license`)** (`AI_LINTLANG`)
- **Speed (`linter_speed`, 1 to 5)** (`AI_LINTLANG`)
- **Icon (`linter_icon_png_url`)** (`AI_LINTLANG`)
- **IDE extensions (`ide`)** (`AI_LINTLANG`)
- **Error counting (`cli_lint_errors_count` and `cli_lint_errors_regex`)** (`AI_LINTLANG`)
- **Default configuration file (`config_file_name`)** (`AI_LINTLANG`)
- **Test fixtures (`test_folder`)** (`AI_LINTLANG`)
